name: Basic Poison
summary: Bonus Action: coat a weapon or 3 pieces of ammunition for +1d4 Poison damage.
text: As a Bonus Action, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the coated weapon or ammunition takes an extra 1d4 Poison damage. The poison stays potent for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever happens first.
